auth_url.description: OIDC Token endpoint. This is the URL of the OIDC authentication endpoint, e.g. `https://auth.example.com/oauth2/token`. It can also be set using the `LAKEKEEPER_AUTH_URL` environment variable.

client_id.description: OIDC Client ID. This is the client ID used to authenticate with the OIDC provider, e.g. `my-client-id`. It can also be set using the `LAKEKEEPER_CLIENT_ID` environment variable.

client_secret.description: OIDC Client Secret. This is the client secret used to authenticate with the OIDC provider, e.g. `my-client-secret`. It can also be set using the `LAKEKEEPER_CLIENT_SECRET` environment variable.

endpoint.description: Lakekeeper endpoint. This is the base URL of the Lakekeeper instance, e.g. `https://lakekeeper.example.com`. It can also be set using the `LAKEKEEPER_ENDPOINT` environment variable.

active.description: Whether the warehouse is active. Default is `true`.

expiration_seconds.description: When the types is `soft`. Entity will be deleted after `expiration_seconds`. Default is `3600`

type.description: Type of the delete profile. Can be `hard` or `soft`. Default: `hard`

delete_profile.description: The delete profile for the warehouse. It can be either a soft or hard delete profile. Default: `hard`

id.description: The internal ID of this resource. In the form: `{{project_id}}/{{warehouse_id}}`

managed_access.description: Whether the managed access is configured on this warehouse. Default is `false`.

name.description: Name of the warehouse to create. Must be unique within a project and may not contain "/"

project_id.description: The project ID to which the warehouse belongs.

protected.description: Whether the warehouse is protected from being deleted. Default is `false`.

account_name.description: Name of the azure storage account.

allow_alternative_protocols.description: Allow alternative protocols such as wasbs:// in locations. This is disabled by default. We do not recommend to use this setting except for migration.

authority_host.description: The authority host to use for authentication. Defaults to `https://login.microsoftonline.com`.

enabled.description: This is just an helper to check if the Azure System Identity is activated for this storage profile.

azure_system_identity.description: Authenticate to ADLS with Azure System Identity

client_credentials.description: Authenticate to ADLS with Client Credentials

key.description: The shared access key. Required for `azure-shared-access-key` credentials.

shared_access_key.description: Authenticate to ADLS with Shared Access Key

credential.description: Configure the credentials to access the ADLS storage. One of `shared_access_key`, `client_credentials` or `azure_system_identity` must be provided. This is not available for imported resources.

filesystem.description: Name of the adls filesystem, in blobstorage also known as container.

host.description: The host to use for the storage account. Defaults to `dfs.core.windows.net`.

key_prefix.description: Subpath in the filesystem to use.

sas_token_validity_seconds.description: The validity of the sas token in seconds. Default is `3600`.

adls.description: ADLS storage profile. Suitable for Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2.

enabled.description: This is just an helper to check if the GCP System Identity is activated for this storage profile.

gcp_system_identity.description: Authenticate to the GCS bucket with GCP System Identity

service_account_key.description: Authenticate to the GCS bucket with a Service Account Key

credential.description: Configure the credentials to access the GCS storage. One of `service_account_key` or `gcp_system_identity` must be provided. This is not available for imported resources.

key_prefix.description: Subpath in the filesystem to use.

gcs.description: GCS storage profile. Designed for use with Google Cloud Storage

allow_alternative_protocols.description: Allow `s3a://`, `s3n://`, `wasbs://` in locations. This is disabled by default. We do not recommend to use this setting except for migration.

assume_role_arn.description: Optional ARN to assume when accessing the bucket from Lakekeeper for S3 storage profile

aws_kms_key_arn.description: ARN of the KMS key used to encrypt the S3 bucket, if any.

bucket.description: The bucket name for the storage profile.

access_key_id.description: The access key ID. Required for `aws-access-key` credentials.

secret_access_key.description: The secret access key. Required for `aws-access-key` credentials.

access_key.description: Authenticate to the S3 bucket with an Access Key

aws_system_identity.description: Authenticate to the S3 bucket with AWS System Identity

access_key_id.description: Access key ID used for IO operations of Lakekeeper

account_id.description: Cloudflare account ID, used to determine the temporary credentials

secret_access_key.description: Secret key associated with the access key ID

token.description: Token associated with the access key ID

cloudflare_r2.description: Authenticate to a Cloudflare R2 Bucket

credential.description: Configure the credentials to access the S3 storage. Only one of `access_key`, `cloudflare_r2` or `aws_system_identity` must be provided. This is not available for imported resources.

endpoint.description: Optional endpoint to use for S3 requests, if not provided the region will be used to determine the endpoint. If both region and endpoint are provided, the endpoint will be used. Example: `http://s3-de.my-domain.com:9000`

flavor.description: S3 flavor to use. Defaults to `aws`. One of `s3-compat` `aws`

key_prefix.description: Subpath in the filesystem to use.

path_style_access.description: Path style access for S3 requests. If the underlying S3 supports both, we recommend to not set path_style_access.

push_s3_delete_disabled.description: Controls whether the `s3.delete-enabled=false` flag is sent to clients.

region.description: Region to use for S3 requests.

remote_signing_url_style.description: S3 URL style detection mode for remote signing. One of `auto`, `path`, `virtual_host`. Default: `auto`.

sts_enabled.description: Whether to enable STS for S3 storage profile. Required if the storage type is `s3`. If enabled, the `sts_role_arn` or `assume_role_arn` must be provided.

sts_token_validity_seconds.description: The validity of the STS tokens in seconds. Default is `3600`.

s3.description: S3 storage profile. Suitable for AWS or any service compatible with the S3 API.

storage_profile.description: Configure the storage profile. Only one Of `s3`, `adls` or `gcs` must be provided.
